svg.text: Bevel drive | source and actual native shaft-height sections
Blue gears/sleeves, red clutch/rivets/shim, purple bearings, green case. Scale retained; no image fitting.
Axial conflict remains: 32.113mm. Printed tooth pitch and bearing envelope constrain the reconstruction.
Support lengths now meet the retained sun/drum datums; this mechanical fit does not establish historical proportions.
The provisional input shaft extends beyond the illustrated end; its bearing/housing/coupling stack is still absent.
Shaft steps, clutch profile, rivet pattern and bearing internals remain inferred; no source pixels are stretched.
